about: Models allowed in this project (brief §4e, principle 3). Each records its license and whether its weights are open; open-weight models are preferred. A model is added only by a reviewed change that quotes the license line from the model's own card, and only if that license clearly allows publishing outputs under GPL-3.0. The composer offers only these; every recipe records the exact model and revision. Hosted models run on a third party's servers; for them the recipe's model record is the endpoint, the date and the host's request id. Local models stay preferred when they can do the job.

models.notes: No separate license per voice; the repository-wide Apache-2.0 covers the voice files. Voice provenance is undocumented (ATTRIBUTION.md). am_michael added 2026-10-13 (owner): the dog-dawn narrator; VOICES.md gives it no CC BY mark (its marks are on some Japanese and French voices only). Each adaptation picks its own narrator.
Runs through mflux (MIT) at 4-bit on Apple Silicon. The model card encourages input and output filters; a public composer should add them.

models.notes: Speech-to-speech: a person's performance spoken in a voice sheet's voice. Part of the Chatterbox release ('Easy voice conversion script'); outputs carry the Perth watermark. The performer agrees to own-voice-v1 first. Performed takes are converted locally (chatterbox-tts, MIT, in .venv-voice) so a raw take never leaves the performer's machine; the hosted endpoint is used for a take only if its performer agrees (owner, 2026-10-13). Raw takes are never published; the recipe records their sha256.

drafting.use: Not used to generate any published image or audio. Drafted inputs: code, read-aloud descriptions of screens and figures, pronunciation word lists, character and location profiles, image prompts, lettering, adaptation scripts, the script of the spoken summary (content/snowmoon/recipes/summary/; owner, 2026-10-10), and the chapter summaries taken from it (content/snowmoon/chapter-summaries.json). Recorded in each affected recipe's `assist`.
